head: 5e164d17b20b655a76c37c2400d8a3c43e0dc5dc
title: fix(invites): resend says re-sent only when an email went out; emailed-invite mismatch named; Codes bulk invite shows per-email results (AUDIT-17-125)
body:
**Tier:** T1 (mobile copy and one navigation target; reads one more field of an existing response).
**Why:** AUDIT-17-125 (invites and bulk invite): three coach/client-visible invite defects on the 10-07 build.
**T4 trigger scan:** none. No auth, RLS/tenancy, PII scope, money, credentials or destructive data change. The attach rules, the intended-email rule and every backend call are unchanged.
**T3 trigger scan:** none. No migration, flag, dependency, lockfile or backend change.
**Bounded T1:** 8 files, 118 changed lines (99 + / 19 -), of which 4 source files 52 lines; the rest tests.
**Canonical builder:** AUDIT-17-125 (agent 125, Claude Opus 5.5).
**Acceptance evidence:** this PR's CI (jest suites below, tsc, lint, R75). Works against current production backend ec12a4b3: `POST /coach/invite-codes/:id/send` already returns `{ status: 'sent' | 'logged' | 'skipped' | 'failed' }`; the attach error code `invite_intended_email_mismatch` already exists; the `BulkInvite` route is already registered in ClientsStack.

## U fixed (each with its one-sentence user story)
- **U-1 Resend claims an email that never went out.** A coach whose client says the invite never arrived taps Resend in Settings > Invites & email and sees "Invite re-sent to alice@...", but no email is sent: the email key `invite:<id>` was spent by the first send, so the backend answers 200 `status: 'skipped'` (and a provider refusal is 200 `status: 'failed'`). Now `skipped` says "No new email sent" and `failed` says "Email not sent", both pointing to Copy link; only `sent`/`logged` says "Invite re-sent". The 404 copy ("Resend isn't supported by the backend yet") said the route was missing; the route is live, so a 404 now means the invite is gone and the list refreshes. The catch copy is specific instead of "Please try again." (`src/api/invites.ts`, `src/screens/coach/CoachInvitesScreen.tsx`)
- **U-2 Emailed invite refused with a generic retry message.** A client invited by bulk email who signs up with a different address (for example Sign in with Apple with Hide My Email) is refused by the emailed code and is told only "Enter your invite code to try again", so retrying the same code fails forever. `invite_intended_email_mismatch` now maps to: "That invite was sent to a different email address. Sign up with the email the invite was sent to, or ask your coach for their coach code and enter it below." (`src/lib/inviteAttachOutcome.ts`; same copy idea as the coachless sheet's CODE_EMAIL_MISMATCH.)
- **U-3 Codes screen opens the legacy bulk screen that hides failed emails.** A coach who taps "Bulk invite from a list" on Codes lands on the legacy CoachBulkInviteScreen, whose summary says "Created: 5" even when some of those emails failed to send. The button now opens `BulkInvite` (the per-email "Sent / Failed" screen with Retry failed), the same screen as Settings > Bulk invite clients. (`src/screens/coach/CoachCodesScreen.tsx`)

## Tests (fail on main where behaviour changes)
- `src/__tests__/coachInvitesScreen.test.tsx`: skipped / failed / sent resend each show the right alert (main shows "Queued ... re-sent" for all three).
- `src/__tests__/invitesApi.test.ts`: `resendInvite` passes `emailStatus` through.
- `src/lib/__tests__/inviteAttachOutcome.test.ts`: the mismatch code gets the named copy (main returns the generic default).
- `src/screens/coach/__tests__/CoachCodesScreen.test.tsx`: the bulk button navigates to `BulkInvite`.

## Overlap
None with open PRs (m#402-m#415 do not touch these files).
Backend follow-up (not in this PR, listed in the AUDIT-17-125 report for the operator): resend should use a fresh email key so it can really re-send; the "Who joined" list should read the InviteRedemption ledger.
